proofs.coverage: TIMP has 8 cache aliases and 16 help replacements; FIMP has 8 aliases and 16 replacements. No scalar sweep retains the original reciprocal expression.
proofs.coefficient_writes: A_PS/B_PS/C_PS are assigned only in TERMIPSterms. Prandtl, Calctb, UVW, Bords and CALCPR do not write them. TKE/EPS/PSIMP/WATVAP retain read-only use.
proofs.range: H_PS column length NZ, producer k=1..NK-1 and consumers k=1..NK-1. Cache slot zero is unused. Upper back-substitution still uses the original field[NK].
proofs.reset: Each new SOLUTION coefficients pass overwrites the needed cache region. Current new-weather and retry paths call TERMIPS before scalar consumers.
proofs.thread_safety: A single producer writes each interior column before read-only consumer sweeps. No new concurrent mutation is introduced.
proofs.types: A/B/C, H_PS, help and pim are double. Horizontal transport and AP0 float values remain in their original coefficient assembly.
proofs.flags: ICT||ICQU guards cache computation. Both consumers are called only under their corresponding enabled flags in SIMPLE.
proofs.ordering: SIMPLE assembles TERMIPS before either scalar. Its Parallel.For completes before consumers. DT updates occur after scalar solves.
proofs.other_consumers: Original A/B/C are retained unchanged for WATVAP, TKE, EPS and PSIMP.
proofs.recurrence: At k=1, cached h=1/A. At every later k, previous pim=B*help is computed in double and used as the original PIM[k-1]. Existing consumer P and Q multiplication/addition order is unchanged.

nonblocking_observations.detail: Both scalars disabled skips reciprocal computation but still allocates the cache in Define_Arrays. This matches the central allocation scheme; include the added memory in evidence.
